mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN pf.authorize_workspace_actor(#{actor.userId},#{actor.spaceId}) THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.space WHERE id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND type='PERSONAL') ELSE false END
SELECT space_id FROM pf.space_storage WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.capability WHERE id=#{capability} AND space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND kind='SKILL' FOR SHARE)
SELECT FROM pf.skill_import WHERE id=#{id} AND space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId}
SELECT FROM pf.skill_import WHERE request_id=#{requestId} AND space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.space_storage SET reserved_bytes=reserved_bytes+#{bytes},version=version+1 WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND committed_bytes+reserved_bytes+#{bytes} <= object_limit_bytes

UPDATE pf.skill_import SET state='UPLOADING',transfer_owner=#{owner},transfer_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '60 seconds',revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND state='CREATED'

UPDATE pf.skill_import SET state=#{state},transfer_owner=NULL,transfer_until=NULL,revision=revision+1, archive_sha256=CASE WHEN #{state}='VERIFIED' THEN declared_sha256 ELSE NULL END WHERE id=#{id} AND space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND state='UPLOADING' AND transfer_owner=#{owner} AND transfer_until>clock_timestamp()
UPDATE pf.skill_import_reservation SET state='RECONCILING',revision=revision+1 WHERE import_id=#{id} AND space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND state='RESERVED'
UPDATE pf.skill_import SET state='QUEUED',revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND state='VERIFIED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.skill_import_outbox(id,space_id,import_id,generation) SELECT #{event},space_id,id,generation FROM pf.skill_import WHERE id=#{id} AND space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND state='QUEUED'
mapper.select: SELECT import_id FROM pf.skill_import_completion_request WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND request_id=#{requestId}
